steps.action: Android tablet: XRecorder screen recorder starts, the user switches to Krita through the recent-apps view (00:00.5-00:02.2)
Krita: a comic page with panel frames; the top-right panel is selected with transform handles
zooms the canvas in on the selected panel
drags the left-edge middle handle of the selected panel left and right, repeatedly, until about 00:19.8
a 'Stop sharing screen?' system dialog appears over Krita; the clip ends at 00:25.2

actual: While the left-edge handle is dragged, the drawn edge of the panel does not follow the handle's dashed outline: at 00:07.75 the edge sits left of the dashed handle line, at 00:12.5 clearly right of it, at 00:15.25 far to the left of it (most of the way to the neighbouring panel), at 00:16.5 right of it again. Between frames the edge jumps between positions rather than moving smoothly with the handle, and the gap is larger at the larger stretches.
decisive: 00:15.25: the dashed handle line of the left edge is well inside the panel while the drawn left edge has jumped far to the left of it
not_visible: that all snapping options are off - no snapping settings are shown
which tool is active (the toolbox is visible but the selected tool is too small to confirm)
the finger or stylus - touch input has no cursor; drags are inferred from handle motion
notes: 1088x720, about 25 s; the first 2.5 s are app switching and the last 1.5 s a screen-recorder dialog.
